verdict.rationale: Community reports say `uv run` sets up the venv and Python install automatically, and docs describe `uv.lock` as a cross-platform lockfile with exact dependency information. Together these suggest a one-command bootstrap, but no item explicitly shows a single command installing every declared dependency on a fresh clone. missing for 10: documented one-command sync of all declared/locked dependencies (e.g. a sync command) on a fresh clone, explicit coverage of dev groups/extras/workspace members, hands-on corroboration of fresh-clone bootstrap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bootstrap a fresh clone with one command that installs everything the project declares

citations.quote: `uv run` handles the venv and Python install
no need to activate env or anything, uv run automatically runs your code through the env.
uv.lock is a cross-platform lockfile that contains exact information about your project's dependencies.
